sources.title: 3DJAKE niceBIO Black
sources.note: 3DJake's own product page for niceBIO, its own brand; its customer service answers a buyer's question on what the filament is made of. Kept for that answer, never for properties.

sources.title: Material Safety Data Sheet: GREENTEC PRO
sources.note: Extrudr's current English safety data sheet for GreenTEC Pro: "bio-copolyester", naming no PLA, where its 2019 edition says PLA-based. Kept as the edition that disagrees. No value is transcribed from it.

sources.title: PLA / Bio-performance Filaments
sources.note: Spectrum's category page for its PLA and bio-performance filaments, which lists GreenyHT and GreenyPro and describes the category as modified PLA. Kept for that statement, never for properties.

sources.title: HI-TEMP filament datasheet
sources.note: One-page BigRep filament datasheet for HI-TEMP (bigrep.com/filaments/hi-temp), linked from the maker's product page as a document viewer.

sources.title: PRO HT Filament - Versatile 3D Printing Material | BigRep
sources.note: BigRep's product page as served for PRO HT Filament - Versatile 3D Printing Material | BigRep (BigRep PRO HT, G168-01): its Recommended Printing Conditions block. The registered sheet leaves nozzle, bed, chamber and drying unpublished.

sources.title: Spectrum Filaments Product Portfolio 2025 — Prografen pp28–29
sources.note: Saved exact original, campaign witness/import pipeline; no source overwrite or edition priority. Targeted original reading only: cover/about and Prografen pp28–29; unrelated catalogue products not researched. The document names its publisher "Spectrum Group Sp. z o.o." (22).

sources.title: GreenTEC
sources.note: Extrudr's product page as served for GreenTEC (Extrudr GREENTEC, G168-04): its Print Settings; Drying block. The registered sheets leave drying unpublished.

sources.title: GreenTEC Pro
sources.note: Extrudr's product page as served for GreenTEC Pro (Extrudr GREENTEC PRO, G168-03): its Print Settings; Drying block. The registered sheets leave drying unpublished.

sources.title: GreenTEC Pro
sources.note: The document names its publisher "Fabru GmbH" (1).

sources.title: GreenTEC (purefil material data sheet)
sources.note: Fabru's one-page German material data sheet for purefil GreenTEC (Materialdatenblatt), linked from purefil.ch's product page "purefil GreenTEC filament": processing data and technical data. It names no polymer; its figures are Extrudr GreenTEC's, which purefil sells under the same name (R179). The document names its publisher "Fabru GmbH" (1).

sources.title: Filament drying - Spectrum Filaments
sources.note: Spectrum's own filament-drying guide: a table of drying time, temperature and the need for drying for each of its filament lines.

sources.title: 3D Printing Filament Manufacturer PRODUCT PORTFOLIO
sources.note: Spectrum's own comparison of its filaments, one row per product: print window, density, and a heat deflection labelled with its ISO 75 method letter ("HDT A - 85°C", "HDT B - 70°C"), the figures its data sheets print, some without the load.
